item.title: New research bolsters evidence that Tylenol doesn't raise the risk of autism despite Trumps claims

item.title: LSU gymnastics struggles at Georgia, loses to Gymdogs for first time in decade
item.description: ATHENS - After an impressive season-opening performance last week for the LSU gymnastics team, the Tigers struggled in a loss at Georgia Friday night.LSU led after one rotation, but continued to make mistakes and had to count a couple of low scores, falling 197.200 to 196.850.LSU's score of 196.850 is their lowest since a meet with Arkansas on January 24 of last year. item.title: TEAM 2 TRAFFIC: I-10 West closed near Whiskey Bay due to 18-wheeler fire
item.description: BUTTE LA ROSE - I-10 West before Whiskey Bay was shut down due to an 18-wheeler on fire, officials said.The Department of Transportation and Development said I-10 West is closed at Mile Marker 131 before LA Highway 975 due to a vehicle fire. Congestion is approaching LA Highway 3000.Video showed an 18-wheeler engulfed in flames. item.title: 2 Make a Difference: The Gardere Initiative
item.description: BATON ROUGE - In this week's 2 Make a Difference, Sylvia Weatherspoon covers the Gardere Initiative, which aims to educate their community and take part in activities.If you know someone who makes a difference, send their name, contact information and a brief summary of their story to sylvia@wbrz.com.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Port Allen basketball holds off U-High
item.description: PORT ALLEN - The Port Allen boys basketball team defended home court Friday night in a win over U-High.The Pelicans led 34-24 at the half, and held on for a 68-60 victory.Port Allen is now 15-6 this season.Permalink| Comments
